'''Ion surge shielding''' was a feature of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[LB-series courier droid]]. It gave the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] a degree of resistance to incurring damage caused by ion fields and [[DEMP gun/Legends|DEMP guns]].
